comment: A candidate country for accession to the European Union, and outside the
common system of VAT until it joins: Shqipëria levies a value added tax of
its own (TVSH — Tatimi mbi Vlerën e Shtuar) under Ligji Nr. 92/2014, datë
24.7.2014, whose article 48 sets the standard rate at 20%, and whose
article 49 carries reduced rates the Ministry of Finance's own Buletini
Fiskal 2024 states at 6% and 10%. `vat_prefix` is null: a taxable person
is addressed by a NIPT (Numri i Identifikimit të Personit të Tatueshëm)
that carries no ISO-style country prefix of this table's kind.
territories.name: Albania
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Albania is a candidate for accession (European Council decision of 24 June 2014) and levies a value added tax of its own, TVSH, under Ligji Nr. 92/2014, datë 24.7.2014, article 48, at a standard rate of 20%.
